    rs = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]

    r_edges = [-1] + rs + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + cs + [w]

    out = []

        line = []

            block = [grid[i][ca+1:cb] for i in range(ra+1, rb)]
            vals = [x for row in block for x in row]
            counts = {x: vals.count(x) for x in set(vals)}

            marker = next((x for x in counts if x != sep), sep)
            line.append(1 if counts.get(marker, 0) >= 2 else marker)

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Full uniform lines partition the grid into independent tiles.
    colors = set(x for row in grid for x in row)
    sep = max(colors, key=lambda c:
              sum(all(x == c for x in row) for row in grid) +
              sum(all(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) for j in range(w)))
    rs = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == sep for i in range(h))]

    re = [-1] + rs + [h]
    ce = [-1] + cs + [w]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(re, re[1:]):
        row_out = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(ce, ce[1:]):
            vals = [grid[i][j] for i in range(r0 + 1, r1)
                    for j in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
            counts = {}
            for v in vals:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
            base = max(counts, key=counts.get)
            anomalies = len(vals) - counts[base]
            row_out.append(base if anomalies == 1 else 1)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
